questions: Which class (CONTRACT_PREREQUISITE / IMPLEMENTATION_FEASIBILITY / IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFICATION / OPERATIONAL_TUNING) preserves the upstream semantic dependency and reopen condition?
sections.completionCondition: Every upstream obligation has exactly one classification with owner, blocks, evidence, and return location.
sections.naRule: N/A only when no upstream obligation exists.

questions: Which context, scope, non-goals, trust assumptions, qualities, accepted risks and rejected mechanisms apply to Goal test/review proposals?
sections.completionCondition: Locked for the Delivery; generic best practice cannot expand the frozen target.
sections.naRule: Not applicable only when the design declares no context.

questions: Which Goals cover every in-scope obligation, with dependencies, Oracle, Harness, Test Ladder and completion relation?
sections.completionCondition: Every in-scope obligation mapped; Walking Skeleton path explicit; no unclassified blocker.
sections.naRule: Not applicable only when the design declares no Goals.

questions: Stable preconditions, input/event, observable result, side effects, Oracle, Harness, dependencies and completion relation?
sections.completionCondition: Every Goal is READY or explicitly classified with a non-implementation blocker.
sections.naRule: Not applicable only when the design declares no Goals.

questions: Interface/Harness calibration, minimum core success, remaining confirmed scenarios, boundary/error/cancellation/recovery, stub replacement, branch correctness, quality thresholds, affected regression?
sections.completionCondition: Each topic is APPLICABLE, reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE, BLOCKED, or authorized DEFERRED.
sections.naRule: Each topic may be reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence.

questions: Runnable, isolated, safe test harness with frozen argv and bound environment/dependency identities?
sections.completionCondition: Harness passes preflight and is bound to the Delivery/Snapshot.
sections.naRule: Not applicable only when the design declares no harness.

template.content:
# Feasibility Evidence

1. Obligation identity and upstream semantic dependency
2. Frozen Harness feasibility phase and exact argv
3. Environment and dependency identities
4. Bounded probe results and limitations
5. Compatible exact binding or inconclusive state

questions: Does the evidence prove a conclusive compatible result with selected binding for every IMPLEMENTATION_FEASIBILITY obligation?
sections.completionCondition: Every feasibility obligation has a conclusive compatible result and selected binding.
sections.naRule: N/A when no feasibility obligation exists.

template.content:
# Test Feedback

1. Rung identity and semantic ladder topic
2. Calibration proof (expected RED or discriminating existing-GREEN via negative fixture/mutant)
3. Test result and exact evidence
4. Flakiness/skip/non-discrimination markers

questions: Does the feedback fail for the expected reason, and is it stable on an unchanged baseline?
sections.completionCondition: Calibrated RED or discriminating existing-GREEN proof; no flaky/skipped/misdirected tests.
sections.naRule: N/A when the rung is a reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE topic.

template.content:
# Review Result

1. Review scope (Goal or whole-scope) and lens
2. Exact candidate identity
3. Admitted Findings or REVIEW_SIGNALs
4. Isolation/barrier evidence

questions: Does every Finding carry exact location, applicable authority, evidence, impact and closure condition?
sections.completionCondition: Findings are admitted with complete shapes; generic best practice stays a REVIEW_SIGNAL.
sections.naRule: N/A when no finding was admitted.

template.content:
# Finding

1. Exact location
2. Observed statement or omission
3. Applicable Goal/context/upstream authority
4. Evidence
5. Concrete impact
6. Severity (BLOCKING/MAJOR/MINOR/REVIEW_SIGNAL)
7. Closure condition and source-lens disposition

questions: Which source lens closes this Finding, against which exact treatment and candidate?
sections.completionCondition: Every Blocking/Major Finding is CLOSED_FIXED or CLOSED_NOT_VALID by its source lens; Minor may be ACCEPTED_MINOR with rationale.
sections.naRule: N/A when no finding was admitted.

sections.naRule: Not applicable until the whole-scope regression passes.
